recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F0F0F0). 2. Add title 'Recall' at top center in large bold red (#D00000) sans-serif. 3. Add yellow circle with '11' at top right corner. 4. Create upper-left gray strip (#E0E0E0) with red underline; inside place 'Correctly Classified (as Positive)' on first line and 'Total objects that should be retrieved (Actually Positive)' on second line. 5. Below that, add cream box (#F5F5DC) with 'Meaning' in red bold, then 'Does the classifier miss any of Positive Objects ?' with 'miss' in red italic and 'Positive' underlined blue. 6. Add red-bordered formula box: 'Recall =' with fraction TP over (TP + FN). 7. Adjacent light-blue box: 'Recall = 28/(28+2)' then '=93.3%'. 8. Below formula, add two beige speech bubbles: left 'Positive Classified as +ive', right 'Positive Classified as -ive'. 9. Under bubbles add red italic line: 'All Positive Samples in the Dataset'. 10. Bottom-left blue box (#E3F2FD with blue border): 'Higher Recall means I HIGHLY trust you if you said I picked ALL Positive Objects.' then 'It Does NOT mean All you said Positive are Actually Positive'. 11. Top-right: first confusion matrix table with header 'Predicted as', columns P/N, row header 'Actual', rows P/N; fill TP and TN green, FN and FP red. 12. Below it, second confusion matrix with same headers; cells: row P has 28 in purple circle and 2 in red circle; row N has 30 plain and 40 in green fill. 13. Bottom-right: two tree diagrams side by side. Left labeled 'Positive' in red: root red circle '30', left child red circle '28' labeled 'TP', right child green circle '2' labeled 'FN'; small airplane icon above root. Right labeled 'Negative' in green: root green circle '70', left child green circle '40' labeled 'TN', right child red circle '30' labeled 'FP'; small airplane icon above root.
